notes: Confidence label is derived from completed job-scoped proof count. Never blocks CV generation. Progression: Starter -> Proof-backed -> Strong evidence.

labels.label: Starter CV
labels.microcopy: Baseline CV tuned to this job.
labels.tooltip: Generated from your existing CV plus the job's skill fit. No proof logged yet. Complete one milestone to upgrade to Proof-backed.

labels.label: Proof-backed CV
labels.microcopy: Includes bullets from your completed milestones.
labels.tooltip: Built from your baseline CV plus proof you logged for this job. Three or more proofs promote this to Strong evidence.

labels.label: Strong evidence CV
labels.microcopy: Multiple proofs tied to this job's core skills.
labels.tooltip: Three or more completed milestones back this CV. Recruiters can trace each claim to a real artifact you produced for this role.

polish_modifier.tooltip: One AI pass reshaped wording. Facts, metrics, and employers are unchanged from your baseline CV and proofs.
